# gramlot-js-server 0.2.9

- Serve the root-page manifest and shared index gallery from Node.js and Bun.
- Export the manifest and icon for serverless directory apps. Single-file output reports unsupported installable-root configuration explicitly.
- Include the optional inspector integration and updated gallery controls/source tabs.
- Validate request media types and UTF-8 input at the HTTP boundary.
- Align server, serverless and generated project minimum dependencies with the core and examples.

Qualification: 33 server tests on Node and Bun, 34 serverless tests and 3 project-template tests; Chromium covers both hosted galleries (41 pages each) and file/directory serverless startup. OS installation and real Safari UI are not newly qualified.
